properties.title: Azure Virtual Desktop Automated Host Pool Deployment

options.text: Automated host pools use a preview Azure Virtual Desktop API and are currently supported only in Azure Commercial. Azure Virtual Desktop creates, updates, and replaces the session-host virtual machines.

This solution deploys a pooled Azure Virtual Desktop host pool using native Session Host Configuration and Session Host Management. Complete each section to configure the control plane, service-managed session hosts, user profiles, security, monitoring, tags, and naming.
Before deployment, create the session-host subnet and an RBAC-enabled Key Vault containing the required VM administrator secrets. Domain-joined hosts also require domain-join credential secrets.
A persona represents a distinct group of users served by this host pool. Define separate personas for groups that differ in density, performance needs, GPU requirements, or business function.

link.label: AVD User Personas - Cloud Adoption Framework

validations.message: The identifier must begin and end with an alphanumeric character and can contain letters, numbers, underscores, dashes, and dots.

options.text: Select a Key Vault that uses Azure RBAC, allows Azure Resource Manager template deployment, and permits trusted Azure services through its network settings. By default, the deployment uses VirtualMachineAdminUserName and VirtualMachineAdminPassword. The host-pool managed identity receives Key Vault Secrets User; secret values are never submitted through this form.

Select a Key Vault that uses Azure RBAC, allows Azure Resource Manager template deployment, and permits trusted Azure services through its network settings. By default, the deployment uses VirtualMachineAdminUserName, VirtualMachineAdminPassword, DomainJoinUserPrincipalName, and DomainJoinUserPassword. The host-pool managed identity receives Key Vault Secrets User; secret values are never submitted through this form.
Secret selection requires Key Vault Reader access to secret metadata and network access from this browser to the selected vault. Leave any override empty to use its default secret name.
Credential secret overrides must be selected from the Credentials Key Vault.
